QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expand to `private_##member` by default, and to plain `member` only when `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is defined.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly states both the default renaming to private_<member> and the unchanged expansion when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined.
